data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 5/6): Per-ensure idempotency assertions for dd-2 (lambda has 4 mutating verbs vs bucket's 1). Split t_rerun_is_no_op: on rerun with STUB_LAMBDA_EXISTS=1 + STUB_LOG_GROUP_EXISTS=1 + STUB_FN_URL_EXISTS=1 + STUB_CONCURRENCY_EQ_10=1, assert ZERO of: create-function, create-function-url-config, put-retention-policy, put-function-concurrency. Without per-verb assertions, dd-2 has false-positive risk for put-retention-policy or put-function-concurrency firing unconditionally on rerun.
